title: Namaz e Nawafil
introduction:
NAMAZ E NAWAFIL

Daily Supererogatory (Mustahab) Prayers: Recommended Nawafil prayers associated with each of the five daily obligatory prayers, establishing deep spiritual proximity and immense divine reward.

verses.translation:
NAFILAH OF FAJR (2 Rak'ats):

Method: It is a 2-rak'at prayer to be prayed when dawn (fajr) falls, before the obligatory Fajr prayer, prayed like the Morning Prayers.

NAFILAH OF ZOHR (8 Rak'ats):

Method: It is an 8-rak'at prayer to be prayed from the beginning of Zawal till before Zohr, offered in four prayers of 2 rak'ats each like the Morning Prayers.

NAFILAH OF ASR (8 Rak'ats):

Method: It is an 8-rak'at prayer to be prayed before the obligatory Asr prayer, offered in four prayers of 2 rak'ats each like the Morning Prayers.

NAFILAH OF MAGHRIB (4 Rak'ats):

Method: It is a 4-rak'at prayer to be prayed after Namaz-e-Maghrib, offered in two prayers of 2 rak'ats each like the Morning Prayers.

NAFILAH OF ISHA (2 Rak'ats - Watirah):

Method: It is a 2-rak'at prayer to be prayed after Namaz-e-Isha, recited in a sitting position like the Morning Prayers.
